newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers Jan same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers Jan same-store sales up.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday comparable-store sales for the month of January rose 7.8 percent to $51.0 million compared with $47.3 million the previous year.
Total sales for January were $56.7 million, down about 160 percent from total sales of $67.5 million for the month last year.

"January's results primarily reflected successful clearance of fall merchandise," Alan Miller, chairman and president. "These results are encouraging, and we are focused on completing our restructuring and emerging from Chapter 11 in mid-1997."

For the year to date ended February 1, same-store sales fell 1.9 percent to $1.02 billion from $1.04 billion the previous year. Total sales for the year were $1.09 billion, a 20.4 percent decrease from the $1.37 billion reported the year before.
